title: useFormField Hook
description:
Implement a `useFormField` hook that returns `{ value, onChange, error, touched, setError, reset }`. `onChange` sets the value and marks `touched` as `true`. `setError(msg)` stores a validation error. `reset` clears all state back to initial.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, onChange, error, touched, setError, reset } = useFormField('');
```
ai_context: Common mistake: forgetting to reset all three pieces of state (value, error, touched) in the reset function — learners often only reset value and miss the other fields.
